title: Type-free GR and statistical follow-up: constructive information requirements

CQG.question: Which additional geometric or optical data suffice to recover an arbitrary source first jet, and what derivative order is necessary in a fixed physical matter class?

JCAP.question: Can an explicitly calibrated observation model test source geodesicity while retaining relative morphology and accounting for finite-distance and kinetic residuals?
include: native observables and latent true distance

tasks.work: Compare exact candidate statements against primary predecessors, including unresolved 2608.07008 body and invariant fluid-characterization literature.
tasks.acceptance: A theorem-level overlap table; mark standard deductions separately from genuinely unlocated claims. Search absence is not proof of novelty.

tasks.work: Inventory actual CF4 and Union3 native measurements, frame definitions, distance zero points, covariance, selection, duplicate objects, and pre-applied velocity corrections.
tasks.acceptance: One immutable per-catalogue observation contract with hashes and explicit missing items. Do not substitute Pantheon+ assumptions for Union3.

tasks.work: Measure angular/radial design leverage and which nuisance columns remove optical modes.
tasks.acceptance: Dimensionlessly scaled singular spectra; reproduce same-radius and radial-angular alias controls; distinguish oracle rank from latent-distance identification.

tasks.work: Implement native mean map, exact source normalization, J_geo, and full joint coefficient likelihood with fixed declared conventions.
tasks.acceptance: Correct c factors, area/luminosity conversion, nonzero absolute intercept, covariance order, and geodesicity vs total-model incompatibility reporting.

tasks.work: Implement finite-distance outer domains, calibration nuisance, and fixed-law projected confidence inversion.
tasks.acceptance: Degrees of freedom equal fixed projector rank; no automatic Wilks; certified feasibility/exclusion or unresolved status. Bounds and selection law frozen before inference.

tasks.work: Determine which actual multifrequency measurements can bound spectral occupation and entropy loss for the selected reference, and which extra number/energy/band moments reduce kernel uncertainty.
tasks.acceptance: External envelope F, entropy budget epsilon, matched moments and instrument kernels documented; if unavailable leave collision bound conditional. Static entropy never substitutes for time/spatial derivatives.

tasks.work: Build the residualized-kernel Gram ellipsoid for jointly bounded observables and a fixed linear collision map.
tasks.acceptance: Positive semidefinite Gram matrix, support/range condition, units, projector space, shared-bias propagation, and linear-operator domain checked.

tasks.work: Select an actual additional information channel for the three free vorticity components.
tasks.acceptance: Either calibrated source spatial velocity derivatives in two nonparallel directions, or independently specified spacetime brightness derivatives and collision moments with a full-rank rotation response. Record what is measurable today and what remains an ideal input.

tasks.work: If homogeneous tilt is targeted, supply independently justified spacelike orbit generators or their normal and verify the symmetry assumptions before contracting with reconstructed u.
tasks.acceptance: Global tilt and local boost remain separately named. Algebraic tilt formula is not a proof of homogeneity or of a Bianchi type.

tasks.work: Compare powers-only, cross-contraction, and full-coefficient procedures at identical design/covariance/nuisance assumptions.
tasks.acceptance: Fixed alternatives, false-positive calibration, power, interval width, remainder and scale sensitivity. Reproduce exact equal-power control before realistic masks.
tasks.runtime: local bounded synthetic study; not executed here

tasks.work: Run actual catalogue inference only after the observation and residual contracts are adequate.
tasks.acceptance: Four-way status, selected-congruence interpretation, scale and remainder sensitivity; no inference of GR violation or Bianchi classification from source acceleration alone.

tasks.work: Explore all-12 first-jet realizability under a fixed Einstein–Euler matter model or a useful common-domain strengthening.
tasks.acceptance: Actual existence proof respecting Euler/Einstein constraints. Treat as new research, not required to validate the already proved local acceleration family.
